authorization.scope: Newly flagged dialogue issues only; separate from historical counts. No reset of unrelated caps.

exactCards.title: Borrowed Authority
exactCards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

exactCards.title: Say You Missed Me
exactCards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll help finish the furniture sale. Sofa goes, but before we decide about my chair, tell me why you've kept it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything. Did you bring its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought it. I'll do the lifting; you only need to decide this: if someone offered twenty pounds, would you keep the chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Chair stays; I'll take its sticker off, if that's all right. You decide where it goes. Could we put the cushion back while I'm sitting in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this sale moving. Your sofa first; why are you keeping the armchair I left here?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It didn't sell. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's in my bag. I'll deal with the sofa while you decide: would you keep the chair if someone made an offer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I sleep with that cushion. May I put it back on the chair and sit with you for a while?

records.repairReason: Owner-flagged repair pass 1: A1 distinguishes B sofa and A left chair; A3 locates cushion in A bag; A5 replaces ambiguous simultaneous sitting/cushion movement and several management clauses with explicit sequential return and shared-presence request. B4 attachment still precedes A5 confession.

spokenDialogueEdit.A1: Get the sale underway and ask why B kept A chair.
spokenDialogueEdit.A3: Answer the cushion question, take a task off B hands, and remove lack of an offer as the easy explanation.
spokenDialogueEdit.A5: Reciprocate B disclosed attachment and ask to return the cushion and sit together; no extra furniture management is needed.

records.reservation: S02 depends on A1/A3 practical management and the willingness to await B answer; it should not be strengthened with another detached authority declaration. Local owner repair pass 1, not fresh review.

exactCards.title: We Needed the Break
exactCards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've arranged lunch for just us. That disastrous family reunion did us a favour; we'll put what we learned to work today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. An audience made us compete. You can start today, and I'll order while you settle in. Nobody has to win the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. I'll explain the change, and you can keep your turn. That reunion taught us to make room for each other before anybody has to storm out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm taking you to lunch, just us. That family reunion was a disaster we needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No audience this time. I'll get us something to eat; you start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Start? You haven't even asked what I want to eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, I'll put my menu down. Order yours first; mine can wait.

records.repairReason: Owner-flagged repair pass 1: remove unsupported waiter headcount and change claim; give B an immediate concern about A ordering for both. A5 enacts yielding the floor rather than stating a general lesson. A1/A3 retain the specific healthy interpretation of the failed reunion.

spokenDialogueEdit.A1: Secure a small lunch together by presenting the failed reunion as useful.
spokenDialogueEdit.A3: Begin the two-person interaction without its previous audience, while arranging food.
spokenDialogueEdit.A5: Let B make the actual food choice and wait; no headcount or summary of a relationship lesson is needed.

records.reservation: The claimed benefit is A interpretation in A1/A3, not a proven cure. A5 only shows one corrected interaction. Local owner repair pass 1.

exactCards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
exactCards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

records.repairReason: Owner-flagged repair pass 1: remove A1 voluntary/please padding and A3 in-charge/adjustment insertion. Preserve the actual tea-to-listening-to-supervision improvisation and transfer of pen control that already enacts dependent authority.

spokenDialogueEdit.A1: Get B into a repair conversation with an apparently clear sequence.
spokenDialogueEdit.A3: Keep B participating by inventing a listening method on demand.
spokenDialogueEdit.A5: Accept B attention concern while retaining a next step and giving B the monitoring tool.

records.reservation: The two cards are naturally close here: D90 supplies improvised relationship repair and S02 explains yielding practical control while preserving the stage-making voice. Local owner repair pass 1; historical score remains unchanged.
